title: ANEEL infraction notices (Autos de Infração), Brazil

series.name: notices
series.description: Number of infraction notices issued in the month by ANEEL and the state agencies acting on its behalf

series.name: penalty_total_brl
series.description: Total value of the penalties imposed in the notices of the month, in Reais (value at issuance, before appeals)

domain: ANEEL, Brazil's federal electricity regulator, publishes every infraction notice (auto de infracao) issued by its inspection areas and by the state regulatory agencies that inspect on its behalf, under ANEEL Normative Resolution 846/2019. Each record is one notice to an electricity company (generation, transmission or distribution), dated when it was issued, with the penalty value.

categories.PDC: Policy-Driven Change: legislation, regulation, agency restructuring or political transition
categories.SP: Seasonal Pattern: a recurring annual inspection cycle
categories.DQE: Data-Quality Event: reporting failure, system migration, backlog, duplication or retroactive correction
categories.GES: Genuine Enforcement Shift: a real change in inspection or enforcement intensity not explained by the above
